claims.statement: The quickstart page is a task-routing entry point mapping user intent (understand, debug, change, test, deploy) to the right wiki page. Key source paths: API routes (backend/app/api/), business logic (backend/app/services/), bot graph (backend/app/graph/), workers (backend/app/workers/), frontend (frontend/src/components/atomic-crm/).

Vietnamese domain terms for TingHire: Quản trị (admin role), Tuyển dụng (recruiter role, default), đồng (VND currency), lead stages NEW/CONTACTING/REGISTERED/SKIPPED, and common desired_job categories (lái xe, công nhân, kho, bán hàng, bảo vệ). The system has two roles (admin, recruiter); Lái xe is a candidate job category, not a system role.
